summary: Master Inclusive Leadership with our advanced 5-day course. Learn to mitigate bias, build psychological safety, and drive DEI strategy.
lede: Inclusive leadership helps senior leaders identify barriers to participation and shape fairer decisions across diverse teams. For senior leaders and executives, the course develops practical ways to recognize unconscious bias, design equitable hiring and promotion processes, and address microaggressions through difficult conversations. It also covers cultural intelligence, psychological safety, allyship, and using inclusion metrics to track progress.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is designed for senior leaders and executives who must drive cultural transformation and operationalize inclusion in complex, diverse environments.
modules: Foundations of Inclusive Leadership and Bias
Leading Cross-Cultural Conflict and Difficult Conversations
Measuring Impact and Driving Sustainable Change
prerequisites: Prerequisites: This advanced course requires participants to have at least 5 years of leadership experience in a managerial or executive role. You must possess a working understanding of basic diversity concepts (e.g., unconscious bias, microaggressions) and be prepared to engage in self-reflection on your own cultural blind spots. No coding or technical data analysis skills are required, but familiarity with organizational performance metrics is essential. Participants should bring a real-world leadership challenge or team diversity issue to apply the learning immediately.
